summary: user options: generate_ssh_key, primary group, supplementary groups (empty removes all), macOS hidden, home path, local commands for centralized auth, and login_class.
questions: How do I generate an SSH key for a new user?
How do I set a user's primary group?
How do I remove a user from all supplementary groups?
How do I manage local users when LDAP is in use?
How do I set a custom home directory?

answer_card.title: user parameters (part 2)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `generate_ssh_key` (false): won't overwrite unless `force`
- `group`: primary group
- `groups`: supplementary list; `''` removes all except primary
- `home`, `local` (luseradd etc.), `hidden` (macOS), `login_class` (BSD)
